name: Soccer Tsuku 2002
summary: Soccer Tsuku 2002 is a soccer management simulation coded by SEGA's Smilebit team. Based on the Japanese Saturn hit, Soccer Tsuku puts you in control of your very own football club. Utilizing full J-League licensing, you can pick your favorite players from both J1 and J2, as well as a select number of famous world soccer players. Assemble your dream team, train it, and take it through the story mode -- or pit it against a friend's team. Soccer Tsuku was only released in Japan.
